title: Dance steers back to the career after Dorsey and Goodman
summary: Dance asks Freeman to cover his thinking in the stretch after leaving Dorsey in 1938 and Goodman in 1939, leading to the Condon band.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Playing in Lionel Hampton's big band

blocks.x: I've made a little error here in allowing you to carry me on almost to the present here and I want you to have plenty of time to talk about the present, but we don't want to skip any part before that, so what we really want to follow is not only the development of the musician, the career, but the development of the musician and the artist. The conclusions that you really -- you really became very, very successful, moved climbed to the top of the ladder and you were conditioned in various ways and your thinking was affected and I would be interested to know what -- the trend of your thinking at that point and where it carried you to, from there.
You're on now, I have put this all on and this is the point now where you'll carry over.
Let's see, what year are we in now?
Well, let us mention a few days. As we said, you left Dorsey in '38 and Benny in '39.
And then I fronted the Eddie Condon Band which we talked about some time ago.
That's right, so would that bring you up to about 1950 -- '40, I mean.
